description: Empirically test whether a lacquer skill needs an edit by mining real session transcripts for friction, proposing a bounded fix, and validating it against held-out cases before it ships. Use when a skill in core/skills/ or profiles/*/skills/ keeps getting corrected in practice, when triaging a scheduled tuning-pass PR, or when skill-authoring-standard's manual rubric isn't enough to tell whether a proposed edit actually helps. Distinct from skill-authoring-standard (a static prose rubric checked by a human) — this is an empirical, evidence-gated loop checked by rollouts.
